#include "unity.h"
#include "include/choose.h"
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

void setUp(void) {}
void tearDown(void) {}

// unit-test-ide:managed-begin case=utc_32ebd393b73c16ed9149506ef93c9f4c function=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb symbol=choose
void test_choose_returns_7_32ebd393b73c16ed9149506ef93c9f4c(void) {
  // Arrange
  // Act
  const int32_t actual = choose(2);
  // Assert
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(7, actual);
}
// unit-test-ide:managed-end case=utc_32ebd393b73c16ed9149506ef93c9f4c

int main(void) {
  UNITY_BEGIN();
  RUN_TEST(test_choose_returns_7_32ebd393b73c16ed9149506ef93c9f4c);
  return UNITY_END();
}
